(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor __configured to detect at least one force influencing the first battery cell while positioned__ within the enclosure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is __configured to detect at least one force influencing the first battery cell while positioned__ between the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell; a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor __configured to detect at least one force influencing the third battery cell while positioned__ between the third battery cell and the second battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: a contact sensor __configured to detect at least one force__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 21: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material __in response to the at least one force__.
